channel.title: Adapy Blog — Adaptive Mobility, Wheelchair Vehicles & NEMT Insights
channel.description: Field notes, research, and stories from adaptive mobility — wheelchair accessible vehicles, NEMT fleet safety, mobility dealer best practices, and driver rehabilitation.

item.title: The Future of Adaptive Mobility: Integration Over Innovation
item.author: support@adapy.com (Sarah Johnson)
item.description: Why the next leap in adaptive mobility is about integrating wheelchair lifts, ramps, hand controls, and transfer seats — not inventing new ones.

item.title: Safety First: Proactive Monitoring in Fleet Operations
item.author: support@adapy.com (Michael Chen)
item.description: How always-on monitoring of wheelchair lifts, CO levels, and cabin temperature is changing NEMT and paratransit fleet safety.

item.title: Compassion Mobility Expanded Business Through Adapy Integration
item.author: support@adapy.com (James Wilson)
item.description: How a mobility dealer expanded service capacity and warranty defensibility by adopting the Adapy connected adaptive mobility platform.
